region: Muthathi / Sangama reach, Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary, Kanakapura taluk, Karnataka
note: No dedicated real-time flow/current gauge exists at Muthathi itself. Nearest monitored points: KRS + Kabini reservoirs (upstream, ~40-60 km, official daily bulletins) and CWC gauge at Biligundlu (downstream, near TN border, portal not machine-accessible). Values below are the closest real, sourced figures and derived estimates - not a live sensor feed.

source: Star of Mysore, 'KRS level falls as outflow to TN exceeds inflow', published 2026-09-03
Star of Mysore, 'KRS level falls as outflow to TN exceeds inflow', published 2026-09-03

method: sum of same-day KRS + Kabini outflow to TN, no routing/attenuation or tributary inflow (e.g. Arkavathy at Sangama) applied
uncertainty: high - excludes travel-time lag, channel losses/gains, tributary contribution, and any local rainfall runoff; velocity cannot be derived without cross-section survey data for this reach

fields_explained.cusecs: cubic feet per second, standard Indian reservoir-bulletin unit
fields_explained.cumecs: cubic metres per second (1 cusec = 0.0283168 cumecs)
fields_explained.confidence: 'reported' = stated directly by an official/press source; 'estimated' = derived by combining reported values, not itself an official figure
